answer_1.quote: We propose a simple prompt-based technique for identifying event causal structures from free-form stories in diverse domains. ... To our best knowledge, this is the first work to demonstrate the practical benefits of causal story structures in automated story understanding, leading to substantial improvements on two distinct tasks, the text-only story quality evaluation and the multimodal story video-text alignment.
answer_1.outputs: causal graphs and story quality scores

answer_2.quote: For COPES, we follow and report accuracy, Micro F1, and Macro F1. ... We compute the precision and recall ... F1 score. ... We report three well-established correlations: Pearson correlation, Spearman rank correlation, and Kendall's tau coefficient.

answer_3.quote: Score the following storyline given the beginning of the story with one to five stars. Where one star means "Nonsense", two stars mean "The storyline has some connections with the beginning, but is not understandable", three stars mean "The storyline has some causal connections with the beginning and is understandable", four stars mean "The storyline is causally consistent with the beginning and possibly involves a few grammar mistakes", and five stars mean "Perfect storyline with causal connections and perfect grammar".

answer_4.quote: Each story is evaluated by five human annotators, each assigning a score between 1 and 5.
